thread:
nora_marketing: Quick ask 11 Need a field-ready one-pager + 1-slide benchmark card for enterprise buyers. Focus: security + SLA tiers + deploy-mode decision path. Target: ship assets next Wed.

devin_product: Sounds good. Keep prose scannable. Suggest sections: Why Redwood, Deploy modes (hosted/dedicated/private), SLA snapshot, Security checklist, Routing/next steps.

rachael_sales: For inbound routing: rule = monthly spend > $6k OR tag: needs-vpc OR vertical: 'regulated'. Route to queue `enterprise-priority` and attach: brief, contact reason, initial usage estimate.

leo_engineering: SLA copy should show concrete SLOs but avoid absolute promises for Hosted. Suggested copy: "Hosted (best-effort): typical p50 80	60ms, p95 35000ms; Dedicated: contractual p99 avail 99.9%; Private: customer-managed uptime." I'll add a tiny table.

ashton_design: I'll do 1p PDF A4 and a single shareable slide. Want icon set for deploy modes + a little benchmark sparkline illustrating cost delta vs self-hosting.

nora_marketing: Two buyer scenarios to call out: 1) Regulated fintech (requires VPC, KMS, audit trails). 2) High-throughput consumer app (Committed Dedicated capacity + autoscale). Keep each to 2 bullets and a single CTA.

devin_product: Add a 1-line benchmark highlight: "Case study: customer X
 3k concurrent sessions, median latency 120ms, 25% lower per-token cost vs baseline via batching+cache." Link to longer benchmark guide.

rachael_sales: AE handoff template: subject line, short summary (1-2 lines), ARR estimate, security flags, next steps. We'll prefill via the inbound form CTA on the one-pager.

kai_ops: Ops notes for Private: typical install window 33 weeks, network allowlist, cert exchange. KMS integrations: AWS KMS, Azure Key Vault, GCP KMS. Add compliance footer: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001.

leo_engineering: Small config snippet we can include in appendix for recommended perf settings:
```yaml
inference:
  batching: workload-aware
  cache: prefix-enabled
  quantization: int8_recommended
  serve_mode: dedicated|private
```

ashton_design: Output plan: PDF, slide, short web blurb (350 words), and a prefilled form URL. I'll post mock by Tue noon.

nora_marketing: Timeline: draft by Tue, review Wed AM, field review Thu, final Wed next week (bit tight). Owners: Nora = PM, Ashton = design, Devin = copy, Rachael = sales handoff, Leo = metrics, Kai = ops checklist.

devin_product: Question: pricing on-sheet? Suggest "Get a tailored quote" + bracketed starting band: "Hosted from $X/mo" (no exacts).

rachael_sales: Agree. Also add "book a 30-min demo + security briefing" CTA. We'll staff with AE + solutions eng.

kai_ops: For Private customers note initial security onboarding steps (KMS setup, SIEM syslog, audit access) and provide a link to the deployment checklist doc.

nora_marketing: Good. Add webinar tie-in: 30-min launch webinar with 10-min demo and live Q&A. We'll promote to trial users with usage > threshold.

ashton_design: I'll include a small callout panel: "Webinar: Secure Deployments with Redwood  Register" and a tiny schedule.

devin_product: I'll draft the short benchmark prose and the deploy-mode decision flow (3-question flowchart).

rachael_sales: I'll map inbound routing logic to Salesforce fields and add the AE template.

leo_engineering: I'll attach the mini spreadsheet of p50/p95 numbers and cost-per-token deltas.

nora_marketing: Perfect. Blocking: need the design mock + product copy Tue morning. If anyone hits delays, ping here. :rocket:

ashton_design: Will post mocks and font assets here when ready.

rachael_sales: I'll test the prefilled form flow and report back.

nora_marketing: Thanks team 11 Closing loop 15-min review Wed 11:00. Add comments to the doc if you can't make it. :thumbsup:
